# dbs-hook: short-video opening optimizer

Curated by Skill Harbor — a short pointer to @dontbesilent2025's short-video opening optimizer: a five-phase workflow that first diagnoses content quality (integrity, material richness, topic breadth) and refuses to optimize when the content itself is weak, then diagnoses the current opening on six dimensions (independence, hook, suspense, credibility, voice-over friendliness, promise match) and generates 10–15 opening variants through material extraction, material supplementation, and suspense creation, ending with a top-3 ranking.
